lens: Interaction and responsive accessibility; all 14 screenshots inspected. Scores concern visible presentation only. Outer card padding, keyboard behavior, semantics, and measured contrast or target compliance are not assessed.

findings: Before layout (8): Warning percentages sit far from their labels. Keep each percentage beside its warning; the after image achieves this.
Before content (7): 'Low 0%' understates exhaustion, while 'loaded' and 'eligible' do not explain freshness. The after image improves both with 'Exhausted', 'left', and 'current'.
After hierarchy (8), down from 9: Account names lose their bold weight while weekly percentages remain bold, weakening the identity of each disclosure row. Give account names medium weight.
After content (8): '3/3 quotas current' leaves the counted unit unclear. Name it explicitly, such as '3/3 accounts current' if accounts are counted.
Before and after colour and responsive/accessibility (8): Secondary labels and the header qualifier are subdued against the dark surface. Brighten that text modestly while preserving the dark design.
Before layout (8): Warning values are detached at the right edge. Group each warning label, state, and value.
Before content (7): Replace 'Low' at zero with 'Exhausted', clarify that percentages are remaining, and describe freshness rather than 'loaded' and 'eligible'; the after image improves these.
After hierarchy (8), down from 9: Regular-weight account names compete with warning text beneath them. Restore modest emphasis to the account names.

After layout (7), typography/numbers (8), consistency (7), and responsive/accessibility (7) regress: 'Exhausted' wraps below 'Cloud Session Credits', but '0% left' remains at the far right of the preceding line; account 2 keeps its state and value together. Put 'Exhausted · 0% left' together on one continuation line when needed, using the same grouping for all warnings.
After content (8): Clarify the counted unit in '3/3 quotas current', for example '3/3 accounts current' if appropriate.
Before colour and responsive/accessibility (8), and after colour (8): Brighten the subdued secondary labels and header qualifier.

Before content (7): 'Low' at zero and bare warning percentages obscure the exact remaining state. The after image improves this with 'Exhausted' and 'left'. Replace the old loaded/eligible summary with an explicit freshness count.
After hierarchy (8), down from 9: Account names no longer stand apart from warning labels by weight. Use medium-weight account names.

After layout (7), typography/numbers (8), consistency (7), and responsive/accessibility (7) regress: Account 1 gains a warning line, with 'Exhausted' below the label and '0% left' isolated at the right; account 2 uses an inline 'Low 14% left' group. Keep each state and value together beneath its quota label when width is limited.
After content (8): Specify whether '3/3 quotas current' counts accounts or quota types; use the corresponding noun.

Before colour and responsive/accessibility (8), and after colour (8): Increase the brightness of the secondary quota labels and summary text. Text already conveys warning states independently of amber.
Before hierarchy and layout (8): The bold, three-line credential name dominates the compact list. Use medium weight and a clearer gap between the identity block and its warning.
After hierarchy (8): Lighter account text reduces the long name's visual mass, but also reduces distinction from quota labels. Medium weight would preserve both compactness and identity.
Before content (7): 'Low 0%' should identify exhaustion, and the loaded/eligible summary should explain freshness. The after image improves these meanings.

After layout (7), typography/numbers (8), consistency (7), and responsive/accessibility (7) regress: The long name still occupies three lines, while 'Exhausted' adds another warning line and separates from the right-aligned '0% left'. Group 'Exhausted · 0% left' on one line beneath the quota label, matching the grouping used for account 2.
After content (8): Clarify what the '2/3' freshness count counts; name accounts explicitly if that is the unit.
Before colour and responsive/accessibility (8), and after colour (8): Brighten secondary quota labels and summary text to make the dense stacked content easier to read.
Before layout (8): Warning values are remote from their labels. The after image improves association by placing each value beside its warning.
Before content (7): Replace 'Low 0%' with an exhausted state and remaining wording; explain the summary as freshness. The after image makes these improvements.
After hierarchy (8), down from 9: Account names lose emphasis while the unavailable message remains visually prominent. Use medium-weight account names so identity leads each column.
After content (8): '2/3 quotas current' does not clearly name the counted unit. Use '2/3 accounts current' if appropriate, retaining the explicit 'Weekly quota unavailable' explanation.
Before and after colour and responsive/accessibility (8): Brighten secondary labels and the summary qualifier. Preserve the unavailable message and dash, which distinguish missing data from zero.
Before layout (8): Warning percentages sit away from their labels. Keep them adjacent, as the after image does.
Before content (7): 'Low 0%' and loaded/eligible wording obscure exhaustion and freshness. The after image improves these; retain the last-observed timestamp.

After hierarchy (8), down from 9: All account names lose weight, weakening identity above the warning lines. Restore medium weight while keeping the stale percentage less prominent than current percentages.

After controls/states (8), down from 9: The new outlined 'Stale' badge resembles a small control beside the percentage. Give this status label a subdued filled treatment or remove its outline so its appearance is less button-like.
After content (8): Name the unit counted by '2/3 quotas current', such as accounts if appropriate.
Before and after colour and responsive/accessibility (8): Brighten secondary labels. In the after image, keep the stale percentage readable while distinguishing it through the explicit status label.
Before content (7): Bare percentages lack local remaining wording, and zero credits are called 'Low'. The after image improves this with 'left' and 'Exhausted'.

After hierarchy (8), down from 9: Account names lose their bold emphasis beside plan metadata and above several detail rows. Use medium-weight account names while retaining smaller, subdued plan metadata.

After colour (7), consistency (7), and responsive/accessibility (7) regress: The empty Cloud Session Credits bar becomes a conspicuous full-length gray strip at '0% left'. Other gray tracks also become brighter, reducing the visual distinction between remaining fill and unused track. Darken tracks and reserve the brighter shade for the remaining portion; zero should have no bright fill.
After content (8): Clarify the counted unit in '3/3 quotas current'; the expanded view visibly contains several quota types per account.
Before colour and responsive/accessibility (8): Reset timestamps and lower metadata labels are subdued. Brighten these secondary text elements; this also remains useful after the change.
